verdict.rationale: Event-triggered automation rules are a fair question for a speech-AI API platform, but the evidence pack never documents a way to define rules that fire actions on events. The passing mention of webhooks in docs-3 belongs to a separate webhooks story, and automatic model fallback (docs-15) is built-in behavior, not user-defined rules.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
